types.name: Box3
types.doc: Positive axis-aligned finished region in millimetres.

types.name: BoxAlgebra
types.doc: Exact orthogonal box set operations. Outputs are disjoint finished volumes, not meshes.

fields.name: coalesce
fields.doc: Remove decomposition seams using exact coordinate equality.

fields.name: retain
fields.doc: Stable fragment IDs depend on exact geometry, never traversal/array order.

fields.name: minimumIy
fields.doc: Exact minimum centroidal second moment about Y over X, in mm^4.

types.name: CastingBounds
types.doc: Exact bounds of axis-permuted box features. General profiles are not approximated.

types.name: CastingCavities
types.doc:
Single source of cut ∩ body. Supported envelopes are disjoint convex prisms
extruded along a coordinate axis (box, chamfered body, flared foot).

types.name: CastingEnvelope
types.doc: Disjoint convex envelope pieces for the supported planar body family.

types.name: CastingFeature
types.doc: Design cut plus declared openings; derive the finished cavity through CastingCavities.

types.name: CastingFeatureCodec
types.doc: Strict source schema; no old box-list encoding is accepted.

fields.name: openingTargets
fields.doc: Openings may name an authored parent after retained supports fragment its cut.

types.name: CastingGeometrySolid
types.doc: Insert recesses preserve their complete source exterior; design cuts stay primitive.

types.name: CastingHoleExits
types.doc:
Exact planar exit-disk/material intersection, with contact-only faces excluded.
Sections use the authoritative finished cavities; no design cut is clipped here.

types.name: CastingOpening
types.doc: Body-face targets are <body ID>.<x-min|x-max|y-min|y-max|z-min|z-max>.

types.name: CastingPatterns
types.doc: Shared design patterns. Cuts carry design intent; openings are explicit.

fields.name: grid
fields.signature: (width:Float, depth:Float, height:Float, wall:Float, sole:Float, roof:Float, rib:Float, ?columns:Int, ?rows:Int):Array<CastingFeature>

types.name: CastingPolygons
types.doc: Exact line intersections; tolerance is used only for coincident geometry.

types.name: CastingPrism
types.doc: Convex planar envelope / exact line-profile cavity piece. Local +Z extrusion.

types.name: CastingSolid
types.doc:
Solid primitive in its own frame: centred in XY, from Z=0 to height.
Insert bodies and design cuts share this geometry. Insert holes remain separate.
A cylinder is exact geometry, never its bounding box for box-only analysis.

types.name: CastingSolidCodec
types.doc: One neutral encoding for solid primitives. The containing document owns versioning.

fields.name: box
fields.doc: Explicit box-only gate; never projects a round body onto a rectangular one.

fields.name: SolidIntersection
fields.doc: Exact cut/body expression; native realization must also validate openings.

fields.name: mouth
fields.doc: Mouth span only; this is not a bounding-box approximation of the insert.

types.name: InsertBoreRelief
types.doc: Enlarged blind bore beyond a short entry thread, continuing to hole depth.

types.name: InsertCrimpedTail
types.doc: Product retention geometry belongs to an insert, never to a casting cut primitive.

fields.name: threadLimits
fields.doc: Thread-only design rules are absent on plain bores, never unknown on taps.

types.name: InsertHoleGeometry
types.doc: Exact stock geometry and mass properties for neutral hole patterns.

fields.name: radialWall
fields.doc: Actual radial stock beside drilling, including counterbore and thread relief.

fields.name: massProperties
fields.signature: (width:Float, depth:Float, height:Float, holes:Array<InsertHole>):{volume:Float, center:{x:Float, y:Float, z:Float}}
fields.doc: Exact insert volume and centroid for disjoint axial drilling patterns.

types.name: InsertMaterial
types.doc: Stock condition is part of the design, not inferred by the tooling adapter.

types.name: InsertOrigin
types.doc: Product identity is separate from its display label and geometry evidence.

types.name: InsertRoles
types.doc: Typed role vocabulary shared by source schemas and neutral validation.

types.name: InsertSpec
types.doc: Exterior and source hole records share one contract for rectangular and round inserts.

types.name: InsertSpecCodec
types.doc: Source and tooling use the same body and holes; document codecs own versions.

types.name: InsertThreadHand
types.doc: Drilling frame +Z points into the insert from its entry face.

types.name: SheetCut
types.doc: A full straight cut through one current rectangular region.

types.name: SheetCutExecution
types.doc: Immutable audit record of one confirmed cut operation. Areas are in mm².

types.name: SheetCutPlan
types.doc: Authored cutting layout, separate from physical inventory and execution history.

types.name: SheetInventory
types.doc: Local, atomic inventory workflow for registering, allocating, previewing and executing cuts.

fields.name: registerSheet
fields.doc: Registration changes inventory only after the complete candidate record validates.

fields.name: editPlan
fields.doc: Persist a manual layout edit and advance its plan revision.

fields.name: editRequirement
fields.doc: Persist changed part requirements. Existing plan fingerprints then report as stale.

fields.name: revalidatePlan
fields.doc: Accept current stock and part revisions as the new basis for a cut plan.

fields.name: preview
fields.doc: Preview is side-effect free and recomputes every material, dimension, and cut check.

fields.name: execute
fields.doc: Confirmed execution consumes the allocated source and creates all outputs in one atomic save.

types.name: SheetPartPlacement
types.doc: Coordinates are measured from the lower-left corner of the full sheet, in plan units.

types.name: SheetPartRequirement
types.doc: A designed part's rectangular cutting blank and acceptable stock.

types.name: SheetPlanExporter
types.doc: CSV cut list and SVG planning drawing. Exports require a currently valid cut plan.

types.name: SheetPlanValidator
types.doc:
Pure rectangular sheet-plan validation and guillotine-cut geometry. All result dimensions
are normalized to millimetres. Plan coordinates use a lower-left origin on the full sheet.
The numerical acceptance tolerance is 1e-7 mm for coordinates and max(1e-6 mm²,
sourceArea × 1e-9) for area balance.

types.name: SheetProjectCodec
types.doc: Versioned JSON codec for authored sheet plans and separate physical inventory history.

types.name: SheetProjectRecord
types.doc: Versioned manufacturing project. Plans are design records; pieces and executions are inventory.

types.name: SheetStockSpec
types.doc: Reusable purchased-sheet description. Dimensions use `lengthUnit`.

types.name: StockPiece
types.doc: One physical sheet or reusable remnant. Its measured dimensions use `lengthUnit`.

types.name: CoreWireAxis
types.doc:
Initial manufacturing inputs; panel joints and load models are added with their planners.
All lengths are mm. Evidence references record provenance, not automatic qualification.

types.name: ToolingCodec
types.doc:
Strict, detached and deterministic records. No native geometry or inventory effects.
Named collections are sorted by ID; profile vertices retain their geometric order.
Inputs are explicitly millimetres; other units require conversion before this boundary.

fields.name: encodeInput
fields.doc: Persist source geometry once when a native source component needs no mold setup.

fields.name: snapshot
fields.doc: Accepts typed records through exactly the same validation as decoded JSON.

fields.name: canonical
fields.doc: Sort object keys as well as named records so field construction order is irrelevant.

types.name: ToolingDiagnostic
types.doc: Stable rule and subject IDs let later CAD and process checks share one report.

types.name: ToolingDocument
types.doc:
Authored manufacturing inputs, separate from sheet plans and inventory.
Schema version and format are supplied by ToolingCodec's outer envelope.

types.name: ToolingIds
types.doc: IDs share one ASCII vocabulary across source and generated tooling records.

fields.name: derive
fields.doc: Reserve suffix space without losing source identity when an ID is long.

types.name: ToolingReadiness
types.doc: Qualification is separate from successful planning and CAD reconstruction.

types.name: ToolingReview
types.doc: Input-contract review only. Passing the codec never establishes fabrication readiness.

types.name: BoxMoldCodec
types.doc:
Version 7 persists this explicit template and its resolved records. On load all records
must equal regeneration from the strict source/setup/recipe document. No native resources.
Hand-edited generated plans are deliberately rejected; edit the source document instead.

types.name: BoxMoldPlanner
types.doc:
Explicit orthogonal box template. Unsupported cuts/orientations fail rather than disappear.
Four independently liftable walls sit in blind bed sockets outside the casting.
The continuous inside lands own casting size; clearance is on the outside of sockets.

types.name: CastHandling
types.doc: Exact orthogonal resin moments and analytic through-bore steel moments, in mm/kg.

types.name: CastingBoxSupport
types.doc: Box-only consumers qualify the exact derived cavities before projecting any region.

types.name: CastingCoreUnit
types.doc: One source core intent, with all foam pieces created around retained supports.

types.name: CastingFeatureStrategy
types.doc: Directions are expressed in mold coordinates, never source coordinates.

types.name: CastingMoldAssessment
types.doc: Source assessment can decline geometry without manufacturing a box stand-in.

types.name: CastingMoldCodec
types.doc: Persist source, process options and resolved plan; load verifies exact regeneration.

types.name: CastingMoldOptionsCodec
types.doc: Strict authored process inputs. Missing physical evidence stays explicit, never inferred.

types.name: CastingMoldPlanner
types.doc:
Orthogonal review template for multiple explicit EPS/former strategies.
All casting dimensions come from the source document. It never adds design cuts.

fields.name: ownershipOrder
fields.doc: Ownership ordering accepts raw caller order, before codec canonicalisation.

types.name: CastingSetup
types.doc:
Mold +Z is upward, gravity is -Z and the open fill face faces +Z.
The setup is tied to the exact input fingerprint, not merely its revision number.

types.name: CastingSourceRegions
types.doc: One source-to-analysis projection. Unsupported geometry has no box substitute.

types.name: CastingStrategies
types.doc: Source intent and recipe rules choose defaults; setups name only explicit overrides.

types.name: CastingToolingInput
types.doc:
A detached, machine-independent design snapshot. Right-handed source coordinates.
No draft, core strategy, anchorage qualification or finishing allowance is inferred.

types.name: CastingToolingInsert
types.doc:
Neutral insert exterior and source drilling patterns, in mm.
Local +Z identifies the mounting-face normal, at the body's height.

types.name: CoreStockSpec
CoreSupports
types.doc: Two explicit support templates; neither establishes adhesive or structural qualification.

fields.name: build
fields.signature: (c:CorePlan, b:MoldBox, r:ToolingRecipe, o:CoreSupportOptions, bed:PanelPlacement, panels:Array<PanelPlacement>, penetrations:Array<PenetrationPlan>):Void

types.name: DatumFixtures
types.doc:
Nominal supports, located by pins and clamped into source steel threads.
Loose pins/screws/masks must be released before the solid-only removal graphs.
No source insert thread or pin hole is invented.

fields.name: add
fields.signature: (p:CastingMoldPlan, i:CastingToolingInsert, face:materia.assembly.AssemblyRecord.AssemblyFrame, datum:MoldVolume, withdrawal:{x:Float, y:Float, z:Float}, bed:PanelPlacement, ?pocketId:String):Void

types.name: InsertFixturePlanner
types.doc: Both mold planners use the same source-thread access and axial depth budget.

fields.name: plate
fields.doc:
Reusable two-plate datum carrier. Only source holes facing the plate are used.
Screw lengths are selected from declared stock after the complete depth budget.
This constructs no thread in tooling and makes no fixture-accuracy claim.

fields.name: select
fields.signature: (hole:InsertHole, insertToMold:AssemblyFrame, supportFace:AssemblyFrame, hardware:ToolingHardware):Null<{entry:AssemblyFrame, engagement:Float, clearanceDiameter:Float, plug:Null<{diameter:Float, length:Float, materialSpec:String}>}>

types.name: InsertQualifications
types.doc: Product provenance survives every planner; nominal geometry data never clears readiness.

types.name: MoldPanels
types.doc: Shared removable five-panel shell; no feature classification or machine dimensions.

types.name: MoldPlan
types.doc: Versioned generated review record. Source document is the reproducible authority.

types.name: MoldVolumeBounds
types.doc:
Conservative occupied boxes for loads/broad-phase checks. Curved profiles use
their complete bounds and cuts are deliberately not credited as displaced volume.
Never use these boxes to assert exact reconstruction or collision.

types.name: MoldVolumeCodec
types.doc: Exact boxes and operation-derived sealing profiles; no tessellation or compensation.

types.name: FabricationSpecCodec
types.doc: A new format, independent of the casting source contract. Unknown fields fail.

types.name: PlateSupport
types.doc: Declared load/material inputs. Evidence is tied to this package's input fingerprint.

types.name: ToolingFabrication
types.doc: Pure fabrication inputs and reports. No CAD, CAM, drawing writers or inventory mutations.

fields.name: layout
fields.doc: Deterministic shelf layout of bounding blanks; not a contour nest or executable sheet inventory plan.

types.name: ToolingLoads
types.doc: Baseline liquid pressure; conservative peak-pressure structural demand, not paste flow.

fields.name: plate
fields.signature: (p:Float, a:Float, b:Float, t:Float, e:Float, nu:Float, ?terms:Int):{deflectionMm:Float, stressPa:Float}
fields.doc:
Navier odd Fourier series for an isotropic, four-edge simply-supported rectangle under uniform p.
Returns centre deflection and maximum centre bending stress. Cutouts/orthotropy are unsupported.

fields.name: beam
fields.signature: (p:Float, span:Float, tributary:Float, width:Float, depth:Float, e:Float):{deflectionMm:Float, stressPa:Float}

types.name: ToolingManifest
types.doc: Portable neutral artifact inventory; file IO and hashing belong to its producer.

types.name: PanelAssemblyPlan
types.doc: Neutral reference checks and graph ordering. All blocking relations come from 3D sweeps.

fields.name: removalOrder
fields.doc: A -> B means B must be removed before A. Deterministic Kahn ordering.

types.name: PanelBlockingRelation
types.doc: A geometric observation supplied by machinekit.tooling, never inferred from datums.

types.name: PanelCodec
types.doc: Strict exact local-part recipe, separate from occurrence placement and qualification.

types.name: PanelContours
types.doc: Single exact-contour boundary used by CAD, drawings and the future CAM bridge.

fields.name: placed
fields.doc: Rigid 2D placement preserves exact arcs, including their signed sweep.

fields.name: relievedRectangle
fields.doc: Exact boundary of a rectangle union four corner circles; no overlapping loops.

fields.name: relievedPolygon
fields.doc: Integrate circular overcuts at concave right-angle roots into the outside loop.

types.name: PanelCoupon
types.doc: Neutral fit coupon: a shared plug and slots marked by total fit allowance.

types.name: PanelGeometry
types.doc: Exact line/circle predicates. No tessellation and no cutter compensation.

fields.name: distanceBetween
fields.doc: Exact line/arc minimum boundary distance, including interior stationary points.

types.name: PanelJoints
types.doc: One constructor owns both finished mating geometries and their assembly datums.

types.name: PanelOperation
types.doc:
One CAM operation, with finished geometry and an explicit setup/tool. No compensation.
Rebate is a pocket with an open side. Drill contours are exact circles.

types.name: PanelPlan
types.doc:
Local part only; its one outside-profile operation owns the exact outline.
Placement/removal belongs to the assembly. Stock Z spans [0, measuredThickness].

types.name: PanelSegment
types.doc:
Directed exact curve. Arcs have a center and signed sweep; lines have null/zero.
A closed circle uses two half arcs, so each arc has distinct endpoints.

types.name: PanelStockSpec
types.doc:
Measured stock for a tooling recipe; all lengths are mm.
materialSpec is a supplier/design reference, not an implicit MaterialLibrary registration.
The selected contact face must be oriented explicitly by the later panel planner.

types.name: CastabilityAnalysis
types.doc:
Cheap screening over exact shared section/fill records. No CFD, adhesion,
geometry edits or duplicate sweep solver.

types.name: CastabilityLimits
types.doc:
Recipe-bound screening assumptions, not qualified process capacities.
Null limits leave the corresponding rule pending. Evidence records provenance.

types.name: CastabilityProposal
types.doc:
A review alternative, never an applied edit or a claim of a routed vent.
Dimensions and locations are finished geometry in mold coordinates, mm.
Unknown parameter mappings remain explicit; the source design owns acceptance.

types.name: CastingLevelOne
types.doc: Source-only screening. No mold planning, CAD, inferred capacities or source mutation.

fields.name: apply
fields.doc:
Explicitly accepted mapped edit, returned as a detached source revision.
Unsupported mappings never become guessed source edits.

types.name: CastingProcessAnalysis
types.doc:
Process checks extend the real mold planner's validations. They never clear
its requests or substitute a separate geometry/readiness decision.

types.name: CastingProcessSpec
types.doc:
Versioned analysis inputs, bound to an exact recipe. Kept separate from the
existing source/mold and fabrication formats; never silently upgrades them.

types.name: CureAnalysis
types.doc:
Cell-centred finite-volume slab, backward Euler conduction and backward Euler
declared Arrhenius/autocatalytic conversion, iterated together at every step. SI internally.
Only declared planar slabs are represented; joints and steel sinks are not invented.

fields.name: section
fields.doc: Callers use ProcessSpecCodec first. This entry also validates its direct inputs.

types.name: FillAnalysis
types.doc:
Exact rectilinear event-plane analysis. Air connectivity is evaluated in the
right-hand limit at each critical height: boxes ending there disappear,
surviving boxes retain their limiting volume. No offset height or pose sampling.
Positive-area faces connect cells; edge/point contacts never vent a pocket.

fields.name: analyze
fields.signature: (sourceId:String, sourceFingerprint:String, processFingerprint:String, region:Array<MoldBox>, boundaries:Array<FillBoundary>, cores:Array<FillCore>, fillHeightMm:Float, densityKgM3:Float, gravityMps2:Float, ?pourRate:Float, ?airEscapeWidth:Float, ?extraLevels:Array<Float>, ?fillObstructions:Array<MoldBox>, ?panels:Array<FillPanel>):FillReport

types.name: FillTooling
types.doc:
Orthogonal material projection. Curved openings are never credited without
an exact model: affected footprints stay blocked and explicitly Unsupported.

types.name: JunctionThickness
types.doc:
Largest Euclidean inscribed sphere in an exact orthogonal union. Exposed
rectangles are exact. Branch-and-bound uses the 1-Lipschitz distance field;
every live cell retains an upper bound, including when the budget is exhausted.
Numerical diameter tolerance is not a recipe/process acceptance threshold.

types.name: MoldOrientationStudy
types.doc:
Explicit candidates, real planner, shared process rules. CAD checks are injected
by MachineKit and never replaced by a second 2D/removal rule set.

fields.name: reorient
fields.doc: Directions follow the source feature; setup coordinates and fill height are regenerated.

types.name: OrthogonalSections
types.doc:
Coordinate-compressed rays span the entire material interval between opposite
physical faces. Boolean partition sizes are never mistaken for wall thickness.

fields.name: cureSection
fields.doc:
Convert an extracted span only after the caller declares its two actual thermal boundaries.
This supplies geometric thickness/source IDs; it does not qualify 3D junction coverage.

types.name: ProcessSpecCodec
types.doc: Strict independent v5 format. Reconstructs typed records after validation.

types.name: ResinCureSpec
types.doc:
All physical properties may be unknown. Reaction enthalpy is per kg RESIN;
specific heat/conductivity refer to the whole aggregate/resin mix.

types.name: ThermalBoundary
types.doc:
Convection coefficient includes any declared panel/covering thermal resistance.
No board, EPS or steel conductivity is inferred from its material name.

types.name: ThermalCoverage
types.doc:
Exact geometric accounting for declared slabs, separate from solver validity,
thermal boundary evidence, junction heat flow and physical qualification.

types.name: ThermalFaces
types.doc:
Geometric screening contacts, not a heat-transfer coefficient assumption.
Mold-contact faces can remove heat; EPS and an undeclared fill face cannot.
Explicit per-face conditions override mold contacts, never the EPS constraint.
